Script.name: vitalshortcuts
Script.script:
--[[ Vital Shortcuts — port of solao_vital_shortcuts (MUSHclient) Sean Stoves, 2026-07-31
'hp', 'mana', 'mv' report where you're at to your channel, for grouping.
This used to be a bigger plugin: it also drew hp/mana/moves gauges and a tick countdown, replacing solao_statmon_gmcp, solao_health_bars_gmcp and Aardwolf_Tick_Timer. The AardwolfMudlet module already does all of that (its 'gui'/'vconfig'), so that half is gone and its display wins. What's left is the one thing the module doesn't cover.
Reads gmcp.char.vitals directly, so it doesn't care whose gauges are on screen. ]]
solao = solao or {} solao.vitals = solao.vitals or {}
local V = solao.vitals local U = solao.util
local CFG = U.load("vitals", { channel = "gtell" })
local KEYS = { hp = "hp", hit = "hp", mn = "mana", mana = "mana", mv = "moves", moves = "moves", }
local LABEL = { hp = "HP", mana = "Mana", moves = "Moves" }
local function now() local v = gmcp and gmcp.char and gmcp.char.vitals or {} local m = gmcp and gmcp.char and gmcp.char.maxstats or {} return { hp = tonumber(v.hp) or 0, maxhp = tonumber(m.maxhp) or 0, mana = tonumber(v.mana) or 0, maxmana = tonumber(m.maxmana) or 0, moves = tonumber(v.moves) or 0, maxmoves = tonumber(m.maxmoves) or 0, } end
local function pct(a, b) if not b or b <= 0 then return 0 end return math.max(0, math.min(100, math.floor(a / b * 100 + 0.5))) end
-- 'hp' / 'mana' / 'mv' - report one line to the channel function V.report(which) local key = KEYS[(which or ""):lower()] or "hp" local st = now() local cur, max = st[key], st["max" .. key] local body = string.format("%s: %s/%s (%d%%)", LABEL[key], U.commas(cur), U.commas(max), pct(cur, max))
if CFG.channel == "echo" then U.note(body) else send(CFG.channel .. " " .. body, false) U.note("-> " .. CFG.channel .. ": " .. body) end end
function V.cmd(arg) local verb, rest = U.split_verb(arg)
if verb == "" then local st = now() for _, k in ipairs({ "hp", "mana", "moves" }) do U.out(string.format("\n <#c8d0dc>%-5s %s / %s (%d%%)<r>", LABEL[k], U.commas(st[k]), U.commas(st["max" .. k]), pct(st[k], st["max" .. k]))) end echo("\n")
elseif verb == "channel" then local c = U.trim(rest):match("^(%S+)") if c then CFG.channel = c U.save("vitals", CFG) U.ok("Vital reports go to: " .. c) else U.warn("Usage: vitals channel <channel|echo>") end
else U.help("Vital Shortcuts", { { "vitals", "print hp / mana / moves" }, { "hp | mana | mv", "report one of them to your channel" }, { "vitals channel <c>", "where those reports go (or 'echo')" }, { "" }, { "Gauges and the tick timer come from the AardwolfMudlet module" }, { "('gui' / 'vconfig'), not from here." }, }) end end
solao.register("vitals", "hp/mana/mv reporting to your channel", V.cmd)
